# Dixon Ticonderoga Tri-Write Triangular Standard Size No.2 Pencils, Yellow, 12 Count (13856)
Brand: Ticonderoga
Category: Writing & Correction Supplies > Pencils

## Features
Triangular ergonomic shape adds comfort and promotes proper pencil grip; Box of 12 number 2 HB yellow pencils; Latex-Free eraser for smudge-free corrections; Pma certified non-toxic; Earn free supplies - visit the prang power website for program information

## Pricing & Reviews
Rated 3.2 from 9 reviews.
Top review: I thought a triangle pencil would be kind of weird but I really do love it. It helps with perfect placement of your fingers, making it easy to write with. They also don't roll off the desk as easily either. They write nicely too. Not sure I could ever go back to the "regular" ones again.Only received 11 out of 12 pencils and the box was broken. I hope the lead is not broken also.I'm thankful these exist. I have a child whohas small motor issues that include difficulty with pencil grip. For him, these tri-writes make the pencil grip a bit easier. Ticonderoga makes excellent pencils. Well worth the price paid.Love these pencils. I won't use anything else. The triangular shape allows for proper placement of the pincer grip which reduces hand fatigue while writing.Love these pencils - great value and used them for required school supplies.These are horrible!!! They are hollow!!!! That's correct, there is absolutely NO lead in these pencils!!!!! Someone please tell me how you are supposed to write with these ???!!!!!!!Great Pencils

## Description
With a rich heritage, and origins dating back to 1795, the Dixon Ticonderoga company throughout history has made its mark through quality, integrity, respect and perseverance. Today Dixon Ticonderoga continues to make its mark manufacturing and marketing writing instruments, art supplies and tools for self-expression. The Ticonderoga tri-write triangular standard size pencil is the new shape in pencils from the people who know pencils best. Write more comfortably with this ergonomically perfect, triangular shaped number 2 pencil. PMA certified non-toxic, it features an exclusive graphite core formula which gives you extra smooth performance. The top quality eraser provides easy, clean corrections. More than a writing and art products company, Dixon Ticonderoga empowers people to take conscious and subliminal thoughts, facts, ideas and dreams, and preserve them using tools that are simply extensions of themselves.

# #2 Triangle Yellow Pencil (12/Pack)

MSRP$2.99 

PRODUCT DETAILS

- TRI-ANGLE PENCIL. Each pack comes with 12 #2 triangular pre-sharpened pencils with latex free erasers; Smooth, consistent lines that are perfect for writing, drawing, and standardized testing
- COMFORT. Triangular body provides a comfortable ergonomic grip while naturally promoting proper hand positioning and reducing hand fatigue; shape also prevents pencil from rolling off your table!
